# AI Business

> AI Business is the all-in-one AI sales partner for Nigerian small business owners.

## What it does

AI Business finds verified local leads who actually need your service, writes and sends the outreach message, generates a professional proposal with your exact price in 30 seconds, books appointments with automatic reminders, follows up on cold leads so no deal dies in your inbox, and tracks every naira — from one app on your phone.

## Core features

- **Lead Finder**: Discovers businesses near you that need your service, with phone numbers and addresses
- **Proposals**: Generates priced proposals in 30 seconds with 6 closing templates (CRM, Website, Social, Booking, Win-back)
- **Booking**: Automated appointment system with reminders that reduce no-shows
- **Follow-up Assistant**: Drafts personalized follow-up messages for cold leads
- **Business Page**: Your own public page at https://www.ai-business.com.ng/biz/your-slug
- **Invoicing**: Send payment links inside proposals (Paystack integration)
- **Auto Review Collector**: Turns happy customers into Google reviews
- **WhatsApp Broadcast**: One offer to every past customer in two taps

## Who it's for

Nigerian small business owners: freelancers, agencies, salons, real estate agents, consultants, service providers. Anyone who needs customers but doesn't have time to chase them.

## Pricing

Free to start. Paid plans unlock unlimited leads, proposals, and automation.

## Contact

Visit https://www.ai-business.com.ng to try it or vote on what we build next.
